summary: Phillips 66 filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly owned subsidiary amended a receivables securitization program on August 20, 2026, via the Fifth Amendment to the Receivables Purchase and Financing Agreement dated September 30, 2024. The amendment establishes an uncommitted facility of up to $250 million, raises the maximum committed facility size from $1.75 billion to $2 billion, and extends the maturity from September 28, 2026 to August 19, 2027. PNC Bank serves as administrative agent and PNC Capital Markets as structuring agent. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation.
